Public Function ospp_RunCommand(command As String, arguments As String) As String
Dim process As New Process()
Dim startInfo As New ProcessStartInfo()
startInfo.FileName = command
startInfo.Arguments = arguments
startInfo.RedirectStandardOutput = True
startInfo.RedirectStandardError = True
startInfo.UseShellExecute = False
startInfo.CreateNoWindow = True
process.StartInfo = startInfo
Dim output As New System.Text.StringBuilder()
process.Start()
output.Append(process.StandardOutput.ReadToEnd())
output.Append(process.StandardError.ReadToEnd())
'process.WaitForExit()
Return output.ToString()
End Function

Name: execute command with output lines
CustomSubs:
Public Sub ospp_RunCommandWithCallback(command As String, arguments As String, callback As System.Action(Of String))
	Dim p As New Process()
	Dim si As New ProcessStartInfo()

	si.FileName = command
	si.Arguments = arguments
	si.RedirectStandardOutput = True
	si.RedirectStandardError = True
	si.UseShellExecute = False
	si.CreateNoWindow = True
	si.EnvironmentVariables("PYTHONUNBUFFERED") = "1"

	p.StartInfo = si
	p.Start()

	Dim t1 As New Threading.Thread(Sub()
		While Not p.StandardOutput.EndOfStream
			Dim line As String = p.StandardOutput.ReadLine()
			If line IsNot Nothing Then callback(line)
		End While
	End Sub)

	Dim t2 As New Threading.Thread(Sub()
		While Not p.StandardError.EndOfStream
			Dim line As String = p.StandardError.ReadLine()
			If line IsNot Nothing Then callback(line)
		End While
	End Sub)

	t1.IsBackground = True
	t2.IsBackground = True

	t1.Start()
	t2.Start()
End Sub
